shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.domain: Echelon 8 Presentation & UX / wrist-mounted PDA projection
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.summary: Wrist PDA World-Space Canvas bypassed by RenderGraph screen-space projector
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.scannerScope: All Assets/_Project source plus prefab/scene YAML; counts only World-Space Canvas hits whose path or local source/YAML context is PDA/Wrist scoped.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.gpuCapabilityGate: Cold runtime gate requires SystemInfo.supportsSetConstantBuffer and graphicsShaderLevel >= 45 before GraphicsBuffer allocation; unsupported targets fail closed with no World-Space Canvas fallback.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.rendererFeatureActivation: Serialized active in PC_Renderer.asset, PC_High_Renderer.asset, Mobile_Renderer.asset, and Quest_VR_Renderer.asset; each m_RendererFeatureMap matches the m_RendererFeatures local fileID order.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.viewSpaceRoute: Shader ray-plane math uses UNITY_MATRIX_I_P view rays and rotates the camera-relative PDA matrix through UNITY_MATRIX_V; no _WorldSpaceCameraPos subtraction remains.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.gpuUpload: LockBufferForWrite plus direct UnsafeUtility.MemCpy; no GraphicsBuffer.SetData
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.depthRoute: _CameraDepthTexture sampled in the PDA shader for soft occlusion
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.qualityLodRoute: Uniform shader math LOD: quality below 0.20 uses one direct atlas sample; 0.20..0.36 fades refraction; 0.52..0.88 fades chroma taps; chroma taps clamp inside the active atlas rect.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.csvProfileSource: Assets/StreamingAssets/Hecton8/PDA/pda_interface_profiles.csv is the direct-file StreamingAssets source with default plus inventory/loadout/construction/barter/data_log/spectrum/atlas_signal/diagnostics rows; URI-backed Android/Quest StreamingAssets fails closed to the deterministic default row until DataMonolith/binary import proof exists; repo-root pda_interface_profiles.csv remains editor/development fallback.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.csvScratchRoute: pda_interface_profiles.csv reads directly into Vault byte scratch 348736 and parses ReadOnlySpan<byte> over unmanaged memory.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.csvTabHashRoute: CSV tokens tab_0/pda_tab_0 and canonical names map to the same ResolvePdaTabHash(int) route as PDAEvents.CurrentTab; unknown names retain FNV fallback.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.shaderWarmupRoute: Assets/_Project/Art/Shaders/Variants/Hecton_PdaScreen_Warmup.shadervariants is serialized in 00_BOOTSTRAP shaderVariantCollections for boot WarmUp.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.editorAsmdefRoute: PdaProjectionTunerWindow remains inside Hecton8.UI.Editor, which references Hecton8.Core where wrist projector runtime types are compiled.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.mockRoute: Mock wrist projection and forced visibility serialize false by default; mock input is accepted only in Unity Editor or DEVELOPMENT_BUILD.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.blackBoxDumpRoute: Editor writes Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_348.bin; player builds write Application.persistentDataPath/Hecton8/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_348.bin. Header v2 is 64 bytes and records valid count/start index before writing telemetry rows oldest-to-newest.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.gizmoRoute: SceneView gizmo converts camera-relative DTO translation by adding the resolved render camera position only for editor drawing.
shinobu_348_screen_space_pda_projector.rollbackBoundary: Presentation-only; Vault IDs 348730..348736 excluded from rollback/save/gameplay truth
